name: Color Wrap
description: Each color channel of the first clip is shifted and wraps around into psychedelic bands while the clips crossfade. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: r_strength
params.description: Shift of the red channel over the transition

params.name: b_strength
